verdict.rationale: Adyen documents its own testing capability: integrations can test different transaction types using test credentials, which implies a separate test environment. The pack never describes that environment as isolated from live data, and docs-26 mentions environments only in passing. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a sandbox/test environment isolated from production data, platform-specific (balance platform) test coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: Test the different types of transactions with Adyen that your integration handles using test credentials
A single key for all your allowed origins in an environment.
